message.blocksouls_common.version_mismat: Your BlockSouls pack (%s) doesn't match this server (%s). Update the pack in the Modrinth App, then rejoin.
advancements.blocksouls.tutorial.root.de: Scavenge, build guns, survive the nights. Each step here says how to reach the next.
advancements.blocksouls.tutorial.scrap.d: Pick up Scrap: break Scrap Piles near wrecks and ruins, or kill wave mobs. Holding it unlocks its recipes in the book.
advancements.blocksouls.tutorial.gunmeta: Mine Gunmetal Ore underground and smelt the Raw Gunmetal in a furnace for a Gunmetal Ingot.
advancements.blocksouls.tutorial.gun_par: Craft a gun part: Barrel = Gunmetal, Iron, Gunmetal in a row. Receiver = Scrap, Gunmetal, Redstone. Stock = Scrap over 2 Planks.
advancements.blocksouls.tutorial.first_g: Build a gun: Barrel + Receiver + Iron Ingot is a Hand Cannon; add a Stock for a Shotgun or Auto Rifle. Copper and Gunpowder make ammo.
advancements.blocksouls.tutorial.find_wr: Find a Kart Wreck beside a road wreck (plains, desert, taiga) and right-click it: it shows the parts it still needs.
advancements.blocksouls.tutorial.fit_par: Right-click the wreck with a Wheel (Scrap, Iron Ingot, Dried Kelp Blocks) and an Engine (Gunmetal, Scrap, Piston, Redstone).
advancements.blocksouls.tutorial.patch_u: Right-click the wreck with Scrap, one piece per click, until the frame is whole.
advancements.blocksouls.tutorial.drive.d: With every part fitted the wreck becomes a Kart: climb in. Sprint while steering to drift; Coal or Fuel Cans refuel it.
advancements.blocksouls.tutorial.first_n: Survive a night until dawn. Waves come after dusk; ordinary wave mobs burn at sunrise. Downed players can be revived by teammates.
advancements.blocksouls.tutorial.first_b: At dawn a Relic drops at your feet: use it and pick 1 of 3 boons. Going down loses them.
advancements.blocksouls.tutorial.field_b: Defeat a field boss. They appear in the overworld during the run; each drops 2 Eyes of Ender and its own materials.
advancements.blocksouls.tutorial.final_r: Open the End with the bosses' Eyes of Ender and defeat the Hollow Sovereign. The world goes endless afterwards.
